hooks.command: if [ ! -d tests/RevitNvf.Core.Tests ]; then echo '[RevitNvf] Core test project not scaffolded yet — skipping (see docs/ROADMAP.md step 1).'; elif ! command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[RevitNvf] .NET SDK not available in this environment — skipping Core tests (build locally with VS 2022 / dotnet).'; else echo '[RevitNvf] Running Core tests...'; dotnet test tests/RevitNvf.Core.Tests --nologo -v minimal || echo '[RevitNvf] Core tests reported failures (see above).'; fi
